summary: Repo-wide grep of apps/api/src for readers of TenantEntity/tenants.active complete. Beyond the 4 known files (leads.service.ts:326, autentique.service.ts, docusign.service.ts, external-data-exchange.service.ts), found two additional readers: (1) apps/api/src/core/guards/tenant.guard.ts:82 (global APP_GUARD, backed by tenant-bootstrap.resolver.ts) -- functionally NOT a billing bypass since BillingEnforcementGuard runs immediately after in the same chain and independently enforces tenant_billing_state with blanket coverage, but it is the exact site the other three files' comments name and itself carries no equivalent annotation or test of the now-vacuous active=false branch -- logged as find-7d412607 (MEDIUM). (2) apps/api/src/modules/auth/dev-auth.controller.ts:47 -- dev-only tenant-selection query implicitly assumed active reflected billing health; now stale, can hand out a token for a suspended tenant -- logged as find-c216b529 (LOW), no production impact. No other production reader of tenants.active for suspension/gating purposes found; unrelated .active/is_active fields on other entities (BillingPlanEntity, OperationalListItemEntity, FinanceCategoryKeywordRuleEntity, OrgMemberEntity.is_active, etc.) are separate columns, not TenantEntity.active, and out of scope. Both new findings logged per ac-9eeb925c -- none left silently unaddressed.
